lessons.advice: Inventory required capabilities and their reachable invocation paths before depending on them.
lessons.applicability: Required task tools or publication channels.
lessons.limitations: Optional advisors need no mandatory installation; metadata supplies no authority.

lessons.advice: Record the governing requirement and disposition before applying advisory findings.
lessons.limitations: Advice cannot grant permission or establish implementation/validation.

lessons.advice: Keep INSTALLED, CALLABLE, EXECUTED and APPLIED independently evidenced, including exact operation and partial coverage.
lessons.limitations: Concept influence and source inspection are not runtime invocation; missing evidence remains UNKNOWN.

lessons.advice: Identify relevant input, transport, log, storage, retention and recipient boundaries before accepting data-flow claims.
lessons.applicability: Forms and integrations that process data.
lessons.limitations: Application demo non-persistence does not prove hosting/provider-wide non-retention.

lessons.advice: Bind public claims to evidence or explicit fictional/demo labeling, including imagery and authorship.
lessons.applicability: Public portfolio content and reference imagery.
lessons.limitations: Visual polish or a photograph cannot prove clients, ownership, awards, coverage or delivered effects.

lessons.advice: Record acceptance criteria, relevant contexts and observed outcomes instead of inferring readiness from a build.
lessons.limitations: Select task-relevant widths and journeys; no universal matrix or certification.

lessons.advice: Separate local source, remote source, deployment source, configured origin and observed live state.
lessons.limitations: Equal hashes may be valid, but each fact needs evidence; documentation and application commits have distinct roles.

lessons.advice: Retain UNKNOWN and UNVERIFIED grades and their impact; preserve missing original reports rather than reconstructing them as executed evidence.
lessons.limitations: Owner disposition, usefulness and a generated report cannot upgrade a missing security fact.

lessons.advice: Treat provider selection/configuration, activation and observed external effects as separate claims with separate authority and evidence.
lessons.applicability: Real provider activation and asynchronous delivery.
lessons.limitations: A UI confirmation, credential presence or mock PASS does not prove a CRM write, email, PDF, analytics or persistence.

lessons.advice: Declare demo/live mode, actual effects, deferred effects and invalid-mode disposition.
lessons.limitations: Fallback-to-demo and specific duplicate status handling are project choices, not production defaults.

lessons.advice: Keep build success, publication success and live behavior verification independently attributed.
lessons.limitations: A build cannot supply a performance score, external effect or public-origin identity.

lessons.advice: Enforce input contracts at the trusted server boundary even when the client validates.
lessons.limitations: A particular framework, schema library, body limit or same-origin mechanism is not a universal authentication rule.

lessons.advice: Verify relevant keyboard, focus, mobile menu, errors and destination behavior, rather than markup or pointer appearance alone.
lessons.limitations: Manual/local checks do not establish formal WCAG, screen-reader or physical-device conformance.

lessons.advice: Test meaningful parsing, type, resource, origin/auth, sanitized error and effect cases selected from the actual interface and threat model.
lessons.limitations: Do not impose universal statuses, sizes, timing constants, honeypots or exhaustive certification.

lessons.advice: Distinguish local timeout/abort from remote execution, cancellation, persistence and cost; reconcile unresolved effects before unsafe retries.
lessons.applicability: External effect lifecycle and duplicate handling.
lessons.limitations: A local abort or transport response cannot settle the remote tail; no blind retry or generic 409 success.

lessons.advice: Bind performance recommendations and numerical claims to measured conditions and actual impact.
lessons.limitations: Northstar numeric evidence remains UNKNOWN; Apex IMP-001 remains DEFERRED; build/console results are not CWV scores.

lessons.advice: Record the applicability and rationale of search/structured-data features for actual content.
lessons.applicability: SEO, metadata, robots, sitemap and public indexing decisions.
lessons.limitations: No universal JSON-LD, noindex or real-business schema requirement; historical missing rationale stays UNVERIFIED.

lessons.advice: Bind evidence to the relevant source/configuration snapshot and revalidate affected conclusions after changes while retaining history.
lessons.limitations: No tag-every-task requirement; frozen scope must not be silently reopened.

lessons.advice: Separate observation, reproduction, cause, disposition, remediation and validation when triage claims could collapse them.
lessons.limitations: NOT REPRODUCED is not false-positive proof or a fixed state; accepted D02 is a bounded documentary refinement, not a lifecycle engine.

lessons.advice: Assess relevant boundary policy, risks and evidence needs when an input boundary is first introduced or materially changed.
lessons.limitations: Accepted D01 requires proportionate evidence, not every-parameter tests or Apex-specific constants; it grants no execution authority.

lessons.advice: Compare a proposed dependency with the existing native/platform solution and its maintenance cost.
lessons.limitations: Native controls/CSS may suffice in one scope while a justified animation dependency may serve another.

lessons.advice: Inspect and measure relevant intermediate layout transitions and content shrink behavior.
lessons.limitations: Exact historical viewport widths are fixtures; the original Meranti overflow culprit is not recoverable.

lessons.advice: Keep diagnostic kind, severity, impact, build/context and unresolved detail distinct.
lessons.limitations: Ready or a clean later console does not prove historical warnings harmless or a full performance/network audit.

lessons.advice: Scope claims to checks actually performed and distinguish REQUIRED, OPTIONAL, NOT_APPLICABLE and DEFERRED.
lessons.limitations: Missing tools/authority do not make mandatory properties non-applicable; partial execution cannot cover a whole tool family.

lessons.advice: Preserve unresolved diagnostic states and obtain separate authority before real contact/provider/payment/deployment effects.
lessons.applicability: Transitions from demo/advisory work to effects.
lessons.limitations: Ownership approval cannot create a missing factual qualification or excuse a mandatory unknown.

lessons.advice: Record dependencies in event scopes, DOM/layout contracts and consumers beyond imports.
lessons.limitations: Static import inspection alone does not prove complete impact coverage.

lessons.advice: Declare shared interaction ownership/state assumptions; coordinate temporary ownership when programmatic behavior competes with observation.
lessons.limitations: Meranti scroll locking is an applicable example, not a universal new runtime state machine.

lessons.advice: Run relevant consumer regression after shared behavior changes.
lessons.limitations: Endpoint-only checks and one component result do not cover all dependent consumers.

lessons.advice: Include meaningful transition states and interruptions in acceptance, not only final endpoints.
lessons.limitations: Select transitions from actual risks; no blanket animation requirement.

lessons.advice: Keep recommendation, implementation, validation and visual approval as distinct claims.
lessons.limitations: Agent readiness is not owner visual acceptance, including Noma Stage 1B.

lessons.advice: Stop when declared acceptance is met; record limitations and explicit reopening conditions rather than continue speculative polishing.
lessons.limitations: A changed or failed visual criterion may justify scoped rework; historical approval does not transfer automatically.

lessons.advice: Define the current-section criterion and sticky-header relationship before implementing active navigation.
lessons.applicability: Single-page navigation where current location matters.
lessons.limitations: Use a layout reference line when product semantics require it; this is not a universal IntersectionObserver ban.

lessons.advice: Keep ordinary scrolling native; use a small cancellable controller for explicit in-page clicks only when the product requires a measurable motion contract.
lessons.limitations: Specify interruption, reduced motion, history and active-state policy; duration/easing remain project parameters.

lessons.advice: Classify all anchor consumers by same-document URL semantics and preserve browser behavior for excluded links.
lessons.limitations: Skip links, external links, downloads and new tabs need explicit exclusions; delegation is not mandatory for every site.

lessons.advice: Compute sticky navigation targets from live layout and CSS-owned offsets, and recheck after transition completion.
lessons.limitations: Avoid unexplained fixed offsets; exact old constants and final positions are not universal defaults.

lessons.advice: Preserve native disclosure semantics and add supported motion as progressive enhancement with a functional fallback.
lessons.limitations: Reduced motion and unsupported CSS must retain usable controls; exact animation tokens are contextual.

lessons.advice: Separate critical/above-fold imagery from supporting imagery and verify positioned, reserved containers across layout transitions.
lessons.limitations: Loading attributes are framework-version/context specific; warning correction does not prove numerical performance.

lessons.advice: Keep truthful portfolio disclosure public while placing implementation instructions and client-replacement tasks in handoff documentation.
lessons.limitations: No universal single disclosure placement; do not remove truthfulness merely to polish copy.

lessons.advice: Update architecture/ownership documentation when a shared client boundary gains responsibilities.
lessons.limitations: Historical README drift remains recorded; knowledge ingestion does not authorize editing a frozen application.

lessons.advice: Keep meaningful static/server-rendered content and scope media-dependent animation lifecycle and cleanup.
lessons.applicability: Optional motion enhancement with viewport/reduced-motion branches.
lessons.limitations: A source branch is not runtime preference verification; Noma reduced-motion execution remains UNVERIFIED.

lessons.advice: Evaluate useful static hierarchy against the actual visual criterion; simplify interaction-dependent presentation when that criterion fails.
lessons.limitations: Noma Stage 1B remains pending owner approval; its photographic/style preferences are not universal rules.

context_versions.summary: Historical committed local release; no animation framework. Preserved as history, not the current dirty configuration.
Later implemented GSAP visual correction; owner visual approval PENDING; no deployment; reduced-motion execution UNVERIFIED.
